subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR land with a custom yielding bootstrap glob walker and yield-between-bootstrap-hook scheduling as the fix for bootstrap-context event-loop stalls?
rationale: The remaining concern is a maintainer tradeoff, not a narrow code defect: the availability win must be weighed against glob compatibility and session-state interleaving risk for existing users.

options.title: Accept the internal tradeoff
options.body: Land after maintainer review acknowledges the residual glob-parity and hook-interleaving risks as acceptable for this P1 stall fix.

options.title: Request one more parity proof
options.body: Ask for a focused before/after comparison of representative bootstrap-extra-files patterns and hook chains before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader scheduling work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want worker-thread or scheduler-level architecture instead of cooperative yielding in this hot path.

recommendation.title: Accept the internal tradeoff
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer review acknowledges the residual glob-parity and hook-interleaving risks as acceptable for this P1 stall fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for both internal hook architecture and bootstrap context ownership points to steipete's prior work on these surfaces.
